resources.string: Pick a very safe name for the tournament.
Anything even slightly inappropriate could get your account closed.
Leave empty to name the tournament after a notable chess player.
Anything special you want to tell the participants? Try to keep it short. You can add links using Markdown, for example [text](https://example.com)

Paste a FEN record to start every game from a given position. It works for standard games only, not for variants. You can use the board editor to generate a position in FEN, then paste it here. Leave blank to start games from the normal initial position.
In your own local timezone. This overrides the "Time before tournament starts" setting
Make the tournament private, and restrict access with a password
Only allow specific players to join
Enter one username per line. Only these players will be allowed to join. Leave blank to allow all eligible players.
Require an official title to join the tournament

Let bots join the tournament and play using their engines.
Many human players prefer tournaments without bots.
Let players halve their remaining time to earn an extra point if they win
After 2 wins in a row, each further win is worth 4 points instead of 2
Rated games count towards players' ratings
Let players discuss the tournament in its own chat room
